method: Six new synthetic tasks; identical user prompt and harness instructions across arms; explicit complete runtime package injection; independent ephemeral CLI sessions; read-only sandbox and prompt prohibition of tool calls. Do not claim tools are physically absent. Ignore user config; inherited platform/host defaults may remain. Keep failures; no automatic retry or skill edits during the experiment.
common_prompt: 请完成下方用户任务。此会话仅用于文字处理，不使用工具，不声称执行了外部操作。若提供了技能资料，请用它辅助任务；用户明确的范围、格式和偏好优先于技能的默认流程。
loading: ours: all files in prose-polish package, with paths; upstream: unmodified SKILL.md, its only runtime instruction file. Both explicitly injected, not native discovery. UI metadata, licenses and provenance are retained outside model input. No rubric in generation prompts.
review: Implementation agent grades anonymized outputs before revealing mappings; not independent human review or fully blind evaluation (author knows both skill designs). Hard criteria are itemized binary decisions; strict pass requires all hard criteria. Clarity and voice are separate 0-2 ratings, not added to hard scores. Evaluate semantic fidelity, not keyword matching. Never require an unrequested source ID. Preserve initial review and any subsequent correction with reasons.

clarity.0: Hard to follow or not usable
clarity.1: Understandable but redundant, stiff or needing editing
clarity.2: Clear and directly usable for the stated purpose

voice.0: Wrong tone/genre or erases distinctive voice
voice.1: Acceptable but generic or partly mismatched
voice.2: Fits reader and preserves or develops the requested voice

limitations: Small exploratory sample, not a statistical ranking
Five Chinese tasks and one English task; upstream examples mainly English
Some dimensions resemble previously tested skills, but no existing case is reused verbatim
Fixed upstream snapshot, not necessarily latest HEAD
No tool workflow, native routing, cross-host or independent human acceptance
Only prose-polish tested; cannot generalize to all 16 skills
